fee_issue.answer: Fee updates usually take 2-3 working days to reflect. If it's been longer, please visit the accounts department with your transaction ID or email accounts@biet.ac.in.

questions: not able to download hall ticket
hall_ticket.answer: Hall tickets can be downloaded from the student portal 3-5 days before the exams start. Ensure your dues are cleared and attendance is above 75%.

exam_info.answer: Exam schedules are posted on the official BIET notice board and website. Mid-exams usually occur in the 8th and 16th weeks of the semester.

results.answer: Results are typically announced by JNTUH 45-60 days after the last exam. You can check them on the JNTUH results portal or the college notice board.

placement.answer: The Training & Placement (T&P) cell is located in the Main Block. They coordinate all campus drives and provide CRT training to final-year students.

admission.answer: BIET offers B.Tech in CSE, ECE, EEE, Civil, and Mechanical. Admissions are primarily through TS EAMCET (College Code: BIET).

hostel.answer: BIET provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls with 24/7 security and hygienic food. Contact the hostel warden at the campus office for registration.

certificates.answer: Requests for certificates (Bonafide, TC, etc.) should be submitted at the administrative office counter between 10 AM and 4 PM.

library.answer: The Central Library is open from 9 AM to 6 PM. Students can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days. Fine for late return is ₹1 per day.

attendance.answer: A minimum of 75% attendance is required to appear for exams. Shortages between 65-75% may be condoned with a valid medical certificate and fee.
